<a id="Build.impl.embed"></a>

### Method `embed`

```silk
pub effect fn embed(self: Self, name: string, input: Deferred<Path>) -> Self
    ! BuildError
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Embeds a file as a generated module in every root compilation.
The file stays deferred and its producer becomes a dependency of each compilation.
A compilation already used as another step's input has frozen settings and cannot be changed.

### Method `write`

```silk
pub effect fn write(self: Self) -> Planned
    ! BuildError
    ? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem | &mut HostInput

Resolves dependencies and publishes requests, stopping before requested compilations run.
Prerequisite tool compilations still build. Failures leave previously published requests intact.

pub struct Job
```

What a custom step's executor runs: one whole graph, with the program's inputs as they were

<a id="Executor"></a>

## `Executor`

```silk
pub type Executor = Arc<Mutex<Option<Pending<Job, Built, BuildError>>>>
```

Runs graphs in this process. Only a registered custom step creates one, so a program whose
graphs the compiler can run carries no runner.

<a id="Built.impl.launch"></a>

### Method `launch`

```silk
pub effect fn launch(self: &Self, arguments: &[string]) -> ()
    ! BuildError | TaskError
    ? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem | &mut HostInput
```

Launches the single completed artifact with inherited terminal streams and environment.
A request's explicit runner takes precedence; WASI defaults to `wasmtime run`.
Use `launchAt` to choose an artifact from a build with several roots.

<a id="Built.impl.launchAt"></a>

### Method `launchAt`

```silk
pub effect fn launchAt(self: &Self, index: usize, arguments: &[string]) -> ()
    ! BuildError | TaskError
    ? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem | &mut HostInput
```

Launches artifact `index`, passing runner arguments, the artifact path, then `arguments`.
A nonzero process status is preserved in `TaskError.status`.

<a id="Built.impl.write"></a>

### Method `write`

```silk
pub effect fn write(self: Self, directory: string) -> Self
    ! BuildError
    ? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem | &mut HostInput
```

Copies completed artifacts, generated headers, and import libraries to `directory`, preserving executable permissions.
The returned paths name the copies; their request files remain at their build locations.
